prompt:

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_YOUNGER_ESCAPE}}

LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_ESCAPE_EXTERIOR}}

PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_ESCAPE_ROBE}}

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence with the precisely timed shots below. Preserve each referenced identity, body proportions, costume and rigid handmade mask. Masks stay fixed to the head with stable features and eye openings; emotion is performed through the body, eyes where visible, breath and hands. All characters are adults. Each listed cut changes the specified physical camera position, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement responds to the actor and follows a possible path in the set; keep the key action readable and focus engaged. Use hard cuts at listed shot boundaries. References anchor design; the written lighting defines exposure and illumination. Preserve the tactile Iranian-inspired world and restrained natural exposure.

LOCATION AND LIGHT
Cool predawn open-sky light over the bare plain. The rear building and city are behind screen left, mountains ahead screen right. Preserve the same robe, mask, exposure and sky brightness throughout this continuous shot.

START STATE AND BLOCKING
Younger alone runs from left to right across the plain in his original clothes and fastened escape robe. Camera is close beside his left side, moving parallel at chest height with a 35mm lens. City and palace remain behind him to the left; all visible characters are this one fugitive.


SHOT 11A | 0s to 15s | 15 seconds
One continuous 35mm handheld tracking shot. 0–5s: the operator runs beside Younger as he pushes through several exhausted steps, robe dragging in the wind, breath broken by sobs. 5–8s: Younger loses speed, stumbles onto one knee and catches himself with one hand on the ground; camera brakes imperfectly and drops with him to kneeling eye height. 8–11s: still kneeling, he turns his head and upper body back toward screen left, toward the city he has escaped; camera makes a small forward arc within his left side so his frightened profile remains readable. Keep that backward eyeline, and let his grip tighten on the robe. 11–15s: he forces himself up, turns again toward screen right and resumes a stumbling run. Camera rises with him and follows. The movement is physically continuous and emotionally unresolved.

END STATE AND EDIT
Younger is alive, moving toward the mountains with his brother left behind. End on his continuing movement. The following community scene begins after a substantial passage of time with a DIFFERENT newly arriving survivor.

SOUND
Uneven running footsteps, wind in the robe, exhausted sobbing, one knee and hand contacting the ground, a caught breath during the backward look, renewed steps.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
